why: Restores the shipped defect: the hull swatches carry no text -- the colour IS the content -- so their only accessible name came from `title`, a tooltip that some screen readers ignore and none promise. The button still LOOKS identical and still has a title, so nothing about the rendered pane changes; only the name goes. Caught by the gives-every-rendered-control-a-non-empty-accessible-name sweep, whose helper deliberately does NOT fall back to `title` -- that shortfall is the assertion, not a limitation of it.
